# OpenDesign Developers

Free public pilot. Create temporary HTML handoffs for user-confirmed editing in OpenDesign Docs.
MCP: https://doc.opendesign.cc/connect/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no authentication)
Tool: opendesign_create_document_handoff
Input: {"name":"report.html","html":"<!doctype html><h1>Report</h1>"}
Output: {"status":"ready","open_url":"...","expires_at":"..."}
Return open_url to the user. Ready is NOT imported. User must open the link and confirm in Docs.
Only upload HTML the user authorized sending to OpenDesign. Anyone holding the link can read it.
HTML is kept in temporary memory for 15 minutes, removed after successful import, and lost on restart.
No URL fetching, model execution, cloud document synchronization, account system or billing.
Limits: 5 MiB UTF-8/document; 30 POST requests/IP/minute; 100 documents and 60 MiB per service.
HTTP 429: rate limited. 503: temporary capacity/concurrency full. Invalid/expired link: 404.
MCP tool-level errors use isError. Do not blindly retry timeouts or claim a document was saved.
Website SDK: https://doc.opendesign.cc/sdk/opendesign.js
ESM: https://doc.opendesign.cc/sdk/opendesign.mjs
Browser websites should use OpenDesign.open({name,html},{docsUrl:'https://doc.opendesign.cc/'}) within a user click.
Only result.ok === true means user confirmation and local save succeeded.
REST spec: https://doc.opendesign.cc/integrate/openapi.json
Guide and interactive example: https://doc.opendesign.cc/integrate/
